rv.q: I guarantee the memories these songs conjure up will get you smiling and the vibrancy of the musicianship will keep your toes tapping.
But if your idea of good fun is to sing and dance along to gems from the Fab Four’s back catalogue, you are definitely in the right place.

cn.t: This Beatles tribute show divides critics: some dismiss it as lacking narrative substance, while others praise its straightforward concert format that lets the iconic music shine.
